mission: Win by intelligence, not just power
goal: Select combinations with small but reproducible advantages under uncertain Kingshot mechanics
inputs: heroes through current generation plus one

evaluation.relativePerformance: Calculate normalized damage or score proxy per scenario; never label absolute damage
evaluation.robustness: Count fraction of explicitly enumerated scenarios in which candidate beats baseline; not an empirical win probability
evaluation.expectedScore: Only use probability-weighted mean when model weights are empirically justified
evaluation.sensitivity: Flag candidate rank reversals when stacking assumptions change
evaluation.costEfficiency: Apply F2P/low/mid ROI criteria separately from whale maximum-performance criteria
evaluation.margin: Keep marginal improvements, but warn when below uncertainty or rounding tolerance

releaseGate.production: BLOCKED until executable regression tests and representative in-game observations
releaseGate.honesty: All scenario probabilities and performance numbers must be labeled model-dependent
releaseGate.designFreeze: Do not modify Command Center home

nextImplementation: Implement deterministic scenario enumeration and robust rank comparison with cross-check tests
